body.message: What loudness does Spotify normalize to?

response.reply: Spotify normalizes tracks to -14 LUFS (Loudness normalization on Spotify).

results.title: Loudness normalization on Spotify
results.snippet: How we adjust loudness We adjust tracks to -14 dB LUFS, according to the ITU 1770 standard. Loudness normalization is applied during playback. We measure loudness levels during the upload process, but we don’t process or change your audio tracks before playback.

results.title: Spotify LUFS Analysis: How Loud Your Mix Should Be in 2026
results.snippet: Apr 7, 2026 · Spotify measures your track's integrated LUFS (loudness over the full duration of the file) and compares it to a target level. On the default "Normal" playback setting, that target is -14 LUFS.

results.title: Mastering for Spotify: LUFS & Loudness Explained (2026)
results.snippet: Spotify turns everyone’s music up or down to a similar loudness, which changes the old “louder wins” rule completely. Here’s how loudness normalization actually works in 2026, what LUFS target to aim for, and how to get a master that stays punchy after Spotify is done with it.
